cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(misra_checker LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# ── LLVM / Clang from your local build ─────────────────────────
# Point this to your LLVM build directory.
set(LLVM_BUILD_DIR "C:/Program Files/llvm-project/build"
    CACHE PATH "Path to LLVM build directory")

set(LLVM_SRC_DIR "C:/Program Files/llvm-project"
    CACHE PATH "Path to LLVM source tree root")

# CMake package configs generated by the LLVM build.
list(APPEND CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH
    "${LLVM_BUILD_DIR}/lib/cmake/llvm"
    "${LLVM_BUILD_DIR}/lib/cmake/clang"
)

find_package(LLVM REQUIRED CONFIG)
find_package(Clang REQUIRED CONFIG)

message(STATUS "Found LLVM ${LLVM_PACKAGE_VERSION}")
message(STATUS "Using LLVMConfig.cmake in: ${LLVM_DIR}")
message(STATUS "Using ClangConfig.cmake in: ${Clang_DIR}")

# Include paths.
include_directories(SYSTEM
    ${LLVM_INCLUDE_DIRS}
    ${CLANG_INCLUDE_DIRS}
    # Source-tree headers (e.g. clang/Tooling/CommonOptionsParser.h).
    "${LLVM_SRC_DIR}/clang/include"
    "${LLVM_SRC_DIR}/llvm/include"
    # Generated headers (e.g. llvm/Config/llvm-config.h).
    "${LLVM_BUILD_DIR}/include"
    "${LLVM_BUILD_DIR}/tools/clang/include"
)

# LLVM definitions (e.g. -D_GNU_SOURCE, NDEBUG for Release).
add_definitions(${LLVM_DEFINITIONS})

# Map the LLVM components we actually need to link libraries.
llvm_map_components_to_libnames(LLVM_LIBS
    Core
    Support
    Option
)

# ── Source files ────────────────────────────────────────────────
set(MISRA_SOURCES
    src/main.cpp
    src/Rule.cpp
    src/ViolationStore.cpp
    src/ProjectFileFilter.cpp
    src/GlobalSymbolDatabase.cpp
    src/MisraChecker.cpp
    # Rules
    src/rules/Rule0/Rule011.cpp
    src/rules/Rule0/Rule013.cpp
    src/rules/Rule0/Rule016.cpp
    src/rules/Rule0/Rule017.cpp
    src/rules/Rule0/Rule018.cpp
    src/rules/Rule0/Rule019.cpp
    src/rules/Rule2/Rule2101.cpp
    src/rules/Rule2/Rule2102.cpp
    src/rules/Rule2/Rule2103.cpp
    src/rules/Rule2/Rule2104.cpp
    src/rules/Rule2/Rule2106.cpp
    src/rules/Rule3/Rule311.cpp
    src/rules/Rule3/Rule322.cpp
    src/rules/Rule3/Rule323.cpp
    src/rules/Rule3/Rule391.cpp
    src/rules/Rule5/Rule504.cpp
    src/rules/Rule5/Rule506.cpp
    src/rules/Rule5/Rule508.cpp
    src/rules/Rule5/Rule524.cpp
    src/rules/Rule5/Rule531.cpp
    src/rules/Rule6/Rule621.cpp
    src/rules/Rule6/Rule645.cpp
    src/rules/Rule6/Rule651.cpp
    src/rules/Rule6/Rule665.cpp
    src/rules/Rule7/Rule711.cpp
    src/rules/Rule7/Rule731.cpp
    src/rules/Rule9/Rule931.cpp
    src/rules/Rule9/Rule933.cpp
    src/rules/Rule9/Rule951.cpp
    src/rules/Rule15/Rule1535.cpp
    src/rules/Rule15/Rule1536.cpp
    src/rules/Rule15/Rule1537.cpp
    src/rules/Rule15/Rule1551.cpp
    src/rules/Rule16/Rule1601.cpp
    src/rules/Rule16/Rule1606.cpp
    src/rules/Rule16/Rule1621.cpp
    # Add more rule .cpp files here.
)

add_executable(misra_checker ${MISRA_SOURCES})

# ── Include our own headers ─────────────────────────────────────
target_include_directories(misra_checker PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/rules
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/rules/Rule0
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/rules/Rule2
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/rules/Rule3
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/rules/Rule5
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/rules/Rule6
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/rules/Rule7
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/rules/Rule9
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/rules/Rule15
)

# ── Link libraries ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Clang libraries (order matters for static linking on MSVC).
target_link_libraries(misra_checker PRIVATE
    clangTooling
    clangASTMatchers
    clangFrontend
    clangSerialization
    clangDriver
    clangParse
    clangSema
    clangAnalysis
    clangEdit
    clangAST
    clangLex
    clangBasic
    clangRewrite
    ${LLVM_LIBS}
)

# On Windows / MSVC, LLVM needs these system libraries.
if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(misra_checker PRIVATE
        version.lib
        advapi32.lib
        shell32.lib
        ole32.lib
    )
endif()

# ── Output directory ────────────────────────────────────────────
set_target_properties(misra_checker PROPERTIES
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/Release"
)

message(STATUS "misra_checker will be built to: ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/Release/misra_checker.exe")

# ── Unit Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
enable_testing()

add_executable(violation_store_test
    tests/ViolationStorePrecedenceTest.cpp
    src/ViolationStore.cpp
    src/ProjectFileFilter.cpp
)

target_include_directories(violation_store_test PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src
)

set_target_properties(violation_store_test PROPERTIES
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/Release"
)

add_test(NAME ViolationStorePrecedenceTest COMMAND violation_store_test)
